notes: country-panel-projection now exposes pure runtime builders, serializers, deserializers, and an empty projection instead of a committed static singleton.
The page server component builds capital and panel projections from the production WorldStateV2 snapshot, then serializes them into GameSetupShell.
GameSetupShell hydrates both search and panel projections before persisted player-country restoration.
game-setup-store no longer imports a committed panel projection and starts with an empty panel projection until hydration.
The dedicated 11-6 projection test proves country rename, country dissolution, and capital ownership changes are reflected by rebuilt panel views.
